summary: Managing macOS Monterey 12, Ventura 13 or later over SSH can fail with eDSPermissionError -14120, which means 'Allow full disk access for remote users' isn't enabled.
questions: I get eDSPermissionError -14120 managing a Mac, what's wrong?
What macOS setting does Ansible need for remote management?

answer_card.title: Fix eDSPermissionError on macOS targets
answer_card.answer_md: `DS Error: -14120 (eDSPermissionError)` on macOS 12+ targets means **Allow full disk access for remote users** is off. Enable it under System Settings → General → Sharing → Remote Login (info icon).
